Court No. - 12
 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J. 
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today in Court is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State; Shri S.S. Rajawat, learned counsel for the complainant and perused the record.
3.

This is the second bail application on behalf of the applicant who seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.161 of 2021, under Section 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Gola, District Lakhimpur Kheri.
3. The first bail application of the applicant was rejected on 03.05.2023.

While arguing the second bail application, learned counsel for the applicant argues that all the witnesses have been examined and the matter was listed for final arguments on 08.04.2025, however, the matter could not be heard on account of a transfer application filed by the informant.
It is stated that now the matter is listed for hearing, however, the applicant has to appear for PCS examination which is scheduled on 12.10.2025.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that all the witnesses have already been examined and the matter is ripe for hearing and the applicant has to appear in the examination, there is no material on record to suggest that the applicant if enlarged on bail at this stage can adversely affect the trial, as such, the applicant who is in custody since 05.04.2021 and has no criminal antecedent is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.
